title: How to contact >x< about a deceased family member's account
description: If a loved one passes away, an authorized family member or estate representative can request to have their >x< account deactivated. This article explains the process for account removal and important information about account access.

crumbs.title: How to contact >x< about a deceased family member's account

runs: In the event of the death of a >x< user, we can work with a person authorized to act on behalf of the estate, or with a verified immediate family member of the deceased to have an account deactivated.

r: Request the removal of a deceased user's account.

runs: After you submit your request, we will email you with instructions for providing more details, including information about the deceased, a copy of your ID, and a copy of the deceased’s death certificate. This is a necessary step to prevent false and/or unauthorized reports. Be assured that this information will remain confidential and will be removed once we've reviewed it.
We are unable to provide account access to anyone regardless of their relationship to the deceased. Read more information about

r: media on >x< concerning a deceased family member

runs: In the event a >x< user is incapacitated, due to medical or other reasons, we can work with a person authorized to act on the behalf of the user to have an account deactivated.

r: Request the removal of an incapacitated user's account.

runs: After you submit your request, we will email you with instructions for providing more details, including information about the user, a copy of your ID, a copy of the account holder’s ID, and a copy of a Power of Attorney authorizing you to act on the account holder’s behalf. This is a necessary step to prevent false and/or unauthorized reports. Be assured that this information will remain confidential and will be deleted once we've reviewed it.
